messages:
Asha: Quick flag 10-min preflight for PulseMD renewal demo tomorrow 9am PT. I sketched a lightweight customer-facing warmup + fallback script. Paste into the invite and shout if you want edits.

Tom: Nice. Can we make the warmup non-invasive (low token count) and include a reproducible latency probe? PulseMD worries about tail latency.

Riley: Proposed preflight (10m) to drop in calendar notes:
1) Goal (30s) - confirm demo success criteria (availability + acceptable wording variance).
2) Low-cost warmup (3m) - 6 requests: 4 short, 2 medium. Use exact demo prompts to prime KV cache and batch lanes.
3) Latency probe (2m) - run the one-liner and share p50/p95/p99 + kv-hit%.
4) Controlled failover (3m) - toggle to fallback model, show Console banner, explain tradeoffs.
5) Capture & next steps (30s).

Kofi: Latency probe one-liner for support shell:
```bash
# send 20 small probes and print simple percentiles
python /opt/tools/latency_probe.py --tenant pulsemd --model open-7b --n 20 --quiet
# then fetch metrics p99
curl -s "$METRICS/api/tenants/pulsemd/latency" | jq '.p99'
```
Outputs p50/p95/p99 and kv-cache-hit% for the invite.

Asha: Customer-facing blurb to paste under demo notes: "If we detect sustained high latency, we'll switch to a faster model variant to keep responses available. This preserves responsiveness but may slightly change phrasing; we'll record any differences and follow up with suggested prompt tweaks and a prioritized fix plan."

Tom: Ops checklist for the call: Console open to "Per-route" view, canary toggle preloaded in staging, tenant logs labeled pulsemd-demo=true for 30m. Keep one engineer on console to flip if needed.

Riley: I added warmup prompts + token estimate (approx 300-600 tokens depending on responses) to the shared doc: https://docs.redwood.example/d/pulsemd-warmup

deploy-bot: [deploy] PulseMD canary: last deploy 2026-03-03T14:10:22Z. No active incidents.

Asha: Owners: Riley - attach prompts and token estimate to invite; Kofi - paste latency probe and repro; Tom - rehearse failover in staging. I'll update invite and include the customer blurb. :thumbsup:

Tom: Done. Rehearsal successful. See you tomorrow.
